en.title: Skills Manager
en.description: Discover, install, check and update DSH skills, with safe removal and restorable backups.

zh.title: 技能管理
zh.description: 检索、安装、检查和更新 DSH 技能，支持安全删除与备份恢复。

userActions: Approve the npm-publish environment for the dispatched Release workflow; the publish job then runs the verified tarball through OIDC and creates the v0.5.1 tag/Release.
Update 技能管理 to 0.5.1 from Plugins (npm installs show the Versions section) or from Discover, then refresh the page once.
In 设置 → 技能管理 the three number cards are clickable filters and a repository install now reveals the installed skill immediately; Electron Desktop visual acceptance is still yours.
